title: Kissed with sweetness Vietnamese pork Nem Nuong
description: A festive Vietnamese dish featuring tender pork, sweet and tangy flavors, and a velvety texture, all while being Whole30-friendly.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs
ingredients.notes: such as mint, basil, or cilantro

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine pork, fish sauce, lemon juice, coconut aminos, granulated sugar, garlic, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
When ready to assemble, fill a large bowl with warm water.
Submerge a rice paper wrapper into the water for a few seconds until it becomes pliable and soft.
Place the wrapper onto a clean surface and arrange a small amount of the pork mixture onto the center of the wrapper.
Add a few fresh herbs on top of the pork mixture.
Fold the bottom half of the wrapper up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Serve the nem nuong immediately and enjoy!
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
